page: Microsoft Azure D32ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading (2 threads per core) on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked up to 4.2 GHz. The CPU architecture includes 480 MB of shared L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 48 KB of L1d cache, supplemented by advanced instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AMX (Tile and INT8), and hardware cryptography (AES, VAES, SHA-NI). Memory capacity stands at 128.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. No discrete GPU hardware is present.

Integrated local storage provides 1888 GB of high-speed NVMe SSD space for applications requiring fast scratch disks or temporary cache storage. In benchmark evaluations, the D32ds_v7 delivers top-tier single-core performance, achieving a Geekbench single-core score of 2232.0 and single-threaded gzip compression of 36.5 GB/sec (both in the top 10%). Multi-threaded compute capacity is consistently strong, reflected in a Geekbench multi-core score of 18166.0, a PassMark CPU score of 54563.93, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression at 231.56 GB/sec. Memory subsystem testing shows large-block read bandwidth of 166.74 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 65.26 GB/sec.

The CPU AMX and vector extensions provide strong CPU-based inference capability, processing 3133.77 tokens per second on small 135M models and 219.58 tokens per second prompt processing on 7B models. Throughput tests show strong static web serving capacity at 59.6 GB/sec, alongside middle-tier database operations and Redis performance handling 61.6 million SET operations per second. With integrated local NVMe storage and balanced compute-to-memory density, the instance offers strong resource efficiency for web serving, microservices, enterprise application tiers, CI/CD compilation workloads, and medium-scale relational or in-memory databases requiring temporary NVMe cache.
description: Microsoft Azure D32ds_v7 is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor clocked at 4.2 GHz, paired with 128.0 GB of RAM and 1888 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Operating on x86_64 architecture with a massive 480 MB L3 cache, it supports AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets for accelerated vector and matrix computing without a discrete GPU. Benchmarks place its single-core capability in the top tier, alongside strong multi-core processing, static web serving throughput (59.6 GB/sec), and robust CPU-based small LLM inference. Its balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio and bundled high-speed local disk deliver an efficient hardware foundation for web services, container clusters, continuous integration pipelines, and database caching workloads.
